Jack&Jones Hagen File Case Bag – Premium 100% PU Leather Laptop File Case (10 Ltrs)

The Jack&Jones Hagen File Case Bag is a premium office and travel companion designed for professionals who value style, durability, and comfort. Made from high-quality 100% PU Leather, this elegant offers a sleek profile with excellent functionality. Whether you need a secure carrier for business meetings or an everyday office essential, the ensures unmatched reliability and a superior user experience.

With a capacity of 10 Lts, this file case is perfectly sized for documents, magazines, chargers, and daily essentials. It features premium-grade YKK Zipper hardware for smooth operation and long-lasting performance. Comfort remains a priority with its Twin Grip Handle and an Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Strap, allowing you to switch between hand-held mode and shoulder carry with ease. The added Luggage Sleeve makes it ideal for work travel, making airport transitions seamless.

The is thoughtfully engineered with 15-inch laptop compatibility, offering secure padding and a structured compartment to protect your device. Whether you are a corporate leader, student, freelancer, or traveler, this premium laptop file case is the perfect upgrade for your everyday routine.

Key Features

  • Brand: Jack&Jones Hagen File Case Bag
  • Capacity: 10 Ltrs – spacious, slim, and structured
  • Material: 100% PU Leather – durable, water-resistant, and premium finish
  • Zipper Quality: Equipped with YKK Zipper for smooth and long-lasting performance
  • Carrying Comfort: Twin Grip Handle for easy hand carry
  • Straps: Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Straps for multiple carrying modes
  • Travel Friendly: Luggage Sleeve for effortless travel and airport convenience
  • Compatibility: Suitable for a 15 Inch Laptop with padded protection
  • Ideal For: Office, meetings, business travel, university, and corporate gifting

Why Choose the Jack&Jones Hagen File Case?

The stands out for its professional aesthetics, travel-friendly features, and durable construction. The 100% PU Leather exterior ensures a rich and sophisticated appearance, while the 10 Ltrs capacity provides ample space without feeling bulky. Its 15 Inch Laptop compatibility makes it an excellent choice for modern working professionals who require secure laptop storage.

The high-performance YKK Zipper ensures durability even with daily usage. The Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Straps reduce fatigue during long commutes, and the Luggage Sleeve adds convenience for business travelers. This file case is a perfect blend of style, comfort, and practicality.

Perfect for Corporate Gifting & Daily Use

With its premium build and sleek styling, the is a popular choice for corporate gifting, employee onboarding kits, business events, and promotional gifting. Its versatile design makes it suitable for executives, students, consultants, and entrepreneurs who prefer organized and stylish carry solutions.
